plain: A safe refuge; today, protection a country gives to people fleeing danger

webster.text: A sanctuary, or place of refuge, where criminals and debtors shelter themselves from justice, and from which they cannot be taken without sacrilege.

more.text: Any place of retreat and security.

example.quote: With equal plausibility might it be alleged in this case, that the favoritism of the latter would always be an asylum for the misbehavior of the former.
